steps.title: What a token is
steps.say: A tokenized fund records your share on a blockchain instead of a broker's private database. PVOO is our practice token. One PVOO stands for one share of VOO.

steps.title: Settlement speed
steps.say: A normal ETF trade settles the next business day. That's the long line. A token on Solana settles in about 2 seconds. That's the short line and the tap.
steps.alt: A long line, then a short line, then a tap.

steps.title: Buy PVOO
steps.say: Done. That settled in {settle_s} seconds. Feel the tap.

steps.title: Check the backing
steps.say: Anyone can check this. On chain there are {supply} PVOO, and our ledger says {ledger}. They match, so every token is backed.

steps.title: The risks
steps.say: Tokens still depend on trust. The issuer has to really hold the shares. Whoever holds the keys controls the tokens. In this app we hold your keys, like a bank would. And the rules for tokenized securities are still being written.

quiz.q: If you lose your own wallet keys, can a bank reset them?
quiz.why: With self-custody there is no reset. Lose the keys and the tokens are gone.
